evals.prompt: Busca referências de landing page de fintech no Dribbble e Mobbin e monta um moodboard.
evals.expected_output: Locks the 5-axis brief, routes platforms, curates 5 to 9 references and writes a reference board.
assertions: States all five brief axes explicitly before searching
Routes to platforms by goal (Dribbble, Mobbin, Awwwards and similar)
Curates 5 to 9 references through quality gates
Writes the board to <project>/.claude/design/reference-board-<slug>.md with steal/avoid notes per reference

evals.prompt: Before building the pricing page, find real design references for typography, palette and motion.
evals.expected_output: Produces a structured reference board covering register, type, palette, spacing, layout and named motion archetypes.
assertions: Extracts register, typography, palette, spacing, layout and motion per reference
Hands off to the build skill (repaint or frontend-craft) after emitting the board
